notes: Both split times come from the print (16:42 and 16:42); no seconds or deltas were invented ('+0 min' is the difference of the two real timestamps). The alarm lines are typed verbatim (JetBrains Mono ligatures disabled so '-->' stays three characters). 'cantou big' is shown inside the print only, not explained. The radar/capture ring is an illustration of 'detecção de shiny'. The typed capture line trims the leading '- ' (after the redacted nick) of '- pokemonCaught ~ I've caught cubone' (trim only, per ASSETS.md); shiny-cubone.png is a 3× upscale, so it is shown at 700 px, below full width.
